rows.en: My father apparently opposed it to the very end. Until he was driven out of the TDF…
If what you're saying is true…
Then what on earth should we do?
We should take Steel Emperor Zephas as an example of what not to be, and rethink how intelligent life throughout the universe ought to live.
What is true peace? And for the sake of all our comrades fighting for it…
we must stop the space fortress's invasion of Earth with everything we have!
You…
I'm fighting prepared to burn up my life, if that's what it takes to make up for my father's mistakes.

It's Brain!

Saburo! Brain has appeared again!
Roger! Let's go, One-Seven!!
What's wrong? One-Seven…
IT IS DANGEROUS BEYOND HERE! WE WILL ENTER THE BRAIN AREA…
The Brain Area?
I WILL TEST THE AREA'S POWER WITH THE SIGCON JET…
NO GOOD! THE SIGCON JET HAS BEEN TAKEN OVER…
It's the Brain Area!
The Brain Area?

It's a computer-control network spread over two kilometers in every direction, centered on Brain!

Brain's powerful electromagnetic waves control every computer within two kilometers…

If One-Seven sets even one foot into that area… One-Seven's computer will be controlled by Brain and manipulated…
Then… One-Seven can't attack Brain…?
No… he can't.
One-Seven! Attack Brain!
ONE-SEVEN CANNOT GO…
ONE-SEVEN CANNOT ENTER THE BRAIN AREA…

One-Seven! We're friends, aren't we?

Let me… let me avenge my parents and my sister! One-Seven!
ONE-SEVEN WILL GO!!
Thank you, One-Seven!
One-Seven!!
One-Seven! The moment you entered the Brain Area, you were finished. Feel the power of the Brain Area!
One-Seven! Can't you hear my voice!? Answer me! One-Seven!!

Come, then!

I'll show you all the difference in power between you and us of the Naager!!

One-Seven…

To grant my wish, you faced Brain knowing the danger…

All because I said something I shouldn't have…
Cheer up! I'm sure Big Angel will come up with the answer!
Big Angel's answer…

I see…

And?
The only way to rescue One-Seven is to destroy Brain…
Only by destroying Brain…?
Then… that's no answer at all!
If we could destroy Brain… we wouldn't be having this much trouble!
Let's do it, Doctor! We'll attack Brain!

It may indeed be possible to destroy him…

But have you forgotten? Brain has a self-regeneration device! No matter how many times you destroy him… Brain comes back.

But, Doctor… for the few minutes while he's regenerating, the Brain Area might disappear!

If the Brain Area disappears, knowing One-Seven… there's a chance he'll escape on his own!
So we bet on those few minutes…
However… we can't use enough forces to attack Brain here and now.

All of this Far East Base's forces are standing by in the stratosphere right now to stop the space fortress from entering the atmosphere!

We can't call them back now.
Let me do it!

But listen… your opponent is Brain!

No matter how capable your unit is, destroying Brain will be difficult…
Our Security Team will back them up too!
Not you too…

Very well, give it a try!

But if you fail, we give up on One-Seven… Is that understood?

Yes, sir!

Chief Kitakura… I won't let your team take the credit!
Roger! And you be careful not to slow us down!

Hah hah hah… The Security Team has really come into its own, hasn't it?

Chief Kitakura, thank you…
Save that for after the mission succeeds! Captain Sawa…
All right… On our end, I'll have Big Angel hurry up with the answer for destroying Brain completely!
Special Forces Unit, commence attack!!
Security Team, back up the Special Forces Unit! We'll attack and destroy Brain!!
No, no… Don't you dare forget about us.
Hey, hey… Don't go forgetting about us, either.
Hey, hey… Don't go forgetting about us, either.
Hey, hey… Don't go forgetting about us, either.
"It's no good! Everyone's watching… I can't transform."
Even all this bombardment can't destroy Brain!?
Captain Sawa!!

Kuh… I told you, didn't I!

I'm prepared to burn up my life to make up for my father's mistakes!

Looks like that chance has finally come around!

Chief Kitakura! Take care of my men… and protect this Earth!

Nuooooooh! Brain, you bastard!!
Captain Sawaaa!!

Captain Sawa…

…!?

His death was not in vain. Brain has been destroyed, and the Brain Area has disappeared!

Saburo, now!!

It seems One-Seven shut down all his own functions so Brain couldn't control him!

Now is the only chance to wake One-Seven up! Get him out of there!
Yes! I'll try!
Listen to me, One-Seven! You fought for me with your life on the line! Now I want to save you, even if it costs me my life.
SABURO… SIT IN THE COCKPIT…

The cockpit?

I see… One-Seven was built so a human could pilot him, just in case!
THAT IS RIGHT, SABURO…
Hang on, One-Seven! I'll set you free right now!
One-Seven moved… It looks like it worked.
Wait! Apfaron!! You're the one I'll never forgive! [HERO4], let's go!!
Wait! Apfaron!! You're the one I'll never forgive! [HERO4], let's go!!
Has Brain regenerated!?

Brain is invincible!

Brain himself will destroy the entire world! Brain cannot be stopped! Brain is all-knowing and all-powerful!

This is bad… At this rate, we can't hold off Brain! It's the same thing over and over!

Let's wait for Big Angel's answer…
Big Angel HQ… is there still no answer?

This is Big Angel HQ…

No answer yet!

…!?

Something's wrong with Big Angel!

Dr. Sahara! Big Angel is running abnormally hot. It's dangerous to continue any further!

uncertain: U14745/U14746: one sentence split across Kitakura and Sawa; cut at the matching point.
U14755: シグコンジェットガ ヤラレタ rendered 'has been taken over' (Brain Area seizes it); could be 'destroyed'.
U14773-U14775: Kitakura relays Big Angel's answer; U14774 Dr. Sahara's 'I see… And?' kept.
U14790-U14793: banter between Sawa and Kitakura kept competitive.
U14798-U14800: identical lines for Furuhashi, Amagi, Soga.
U14804-U14806: Captain Sawa sacrifices himself here; translated as written.
